units.source_text: 名人断然把嗜好的晚酌和香烟戒掉了。

en.t: The Master resolutely gave up his cherished evening drinks and cigarettes.

units.source_text: 他在箱根几乎不走动，如今在伊东努力到户外运动运动，想多吃点东西了。

en.t: In Hakone he had hardly moved around at all, but now in Ito he made an effort to exercise outdoors and wanted to eat a little more.

units.source_text: 他还将白发染黑，也许就是那种决心的表现。

en.t: He also dyed his white hair black, which may have been another sign of that resolve.
